sentences.text: A HARE one day ridiculed the short feet and slow pace of the Tortoise, who replied, laughing: “Though you be swift as the wind, I will beat you in a race.”

sentences.readingHintZh: 叙述主干是 A HARE ... ridiculed ...；who replied 修饰 the Tortoise，laughing 说明乌龟回答时的状态。引号中是乌龟的话：Though you be swift as the wind 为让步从句，I will beat you in a race 为主句。不要把引语中的 I will beat 当作整段叙述的主干。

sentences.text: The Hare, believing her assertion to be simply impossible, assented to the proposal; and they agreed that the Fox should choose the course and fix the goal.

sentences.text: On the day appointed for the race the two started together.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 the two started together，the two 指两位参赛者，started 是谓语。On the day appointed for the race 是时间状语；appointed for the race 为过去分词短语，修饰 day，不要把 started 所在的主句误判为定语从句。

sentences.text: The Tortoise never for a moment stopped, but went on with a slow but steady pace straight to the end of the course.

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“The Hare, lying down by the wayside,”，再看句法中心“fell”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“fast asleep”，确认动作对象或说明内容。

existingAnnotation.text: The Hare, lying down by the wayside, fell fast asleep.
existingAnnotation.translation: 兔子躺在路边，沉沉地睡着了。
existingAnnotation.analysis: The Hare 是主语，fell 是谓语；asleep 是表语，fall asleep 表示“入睡”。lying down by the wayside 是插入的现在分词短语，说明兔子的姿态；fast asleep 意为“熟睡”。

sentences.text: At last waking up, and moving as fast as he could, he saw the Tortoise had reached the goal, and was comfortably dozing after her fatigue.

sentences.text: Slow but steady wins the race.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 这是寓意句：Slow but steady 表示“缓慢却持续稳健的做法”，整体作主语；wins 是谓语动词，the race 是宾语。but 连接 slow 与 steady，突出速度慢但不中断；这里不是说 wins 为非动词。
